ModuleDescription: Fork of UnifiedPicoModule 0.4.0 with MouthLink: an optional mouth model trained on your own PICO 4 Pro mouth-camera frames (tongue directions, separate cheeks, lip tighteners), run inside the module. PICO eye and face tracking for VRCFaceTracking, receiving data from PicoFacialBridge, PICO Connect, Streaming Assistant, or PicoFacialDataDaemon. Gaze comes from the EyeLook expression model and eyelids from 1 - EyeBlink; native eye packets supply a measured pupil diameter. Supports independent per-eye eye expressions and configurable expression processing.
UsageInstructions: Disable older PICO tracking modules, install this module, and restart VRCFaceTracking 5.4.5. Gaze is derived from the EyeLook shapes and eyelid openness from 1 - EyeBlink for every sender. With PicoET-Enhance v2.3.0+ and PicoFacialBridge v0.5.0+, per-eye independent eye-expression X packets (v2: separate left-eye, right-eye and mouth clocks) and measured pupil diameter are supported; an invalid eye holds its own last value. EyeWide is amplified 2x; other expression corrections are off. Explicit settings in UnifiedPicoModule.json take precedence. See the README for configuration and validation details.
